messages:
Renee (AE): Heads-up: BridgeFlow POC — 10 business days. Customer wants a frictionless hosted key start but expects a mid-POC migration path to Dedicated + VPC peering if perf checks out. They require EU data residency and client-managed KMS. Need a short internal onboarding checklist and clear owner assignments.
Kai (SE): I can own onboarding and the quickstart. Need expected peak qps, whether embeddings will be used, and the model family preference. Also will prep a short procurement FAQ.
Renee (AE): They estimate ~80 rps peak (chat-heavy) and plan to enable embeddings in week 2. Prefer open models. EU-only.
Noah (Platform): Hosted path = trial org + ephemeral API key + org billing cap. Dedicated sizing: baseline 1x8 GPU with autoscale; prewarm KV cache if deterministic evals needed. VPC peering needs infra intake + peering CIDR; lead time ~7-12bd.
Zara (Security): Noted: SOC2 required, BYO-KMS (tenant-scoped) preferred, short retention (30d). I'll draft security questionnaire responses and a BYO-KMS checklist.
Kai (SE): Proposed concise runbook:
- Step 1: Create trial org bridgeflow-poc (eu-west-1) and generate ephemeral API key
- Step 2: Apply rate limit (80 rps) + billing cap $1,500 and set usage alerts at 70%
- Step 3: Share quickstart repo + cURL + SDK examples and deterministic test (temp=0)
- Step 4: Collect ops + security contacts, confirm allowed data types and NDA scope
- Step 5: If Dedicated requested mid-POC, open infra ticket for Dedicated + peering and schedule sizing call with Noah
Noah (Platform): Internal CLI examples (dev-only):
```
rwctl org create --name "bridgeflow-poc" --region eu-west-1 --tier trial
rwctl api-keys create --org bridgeflow-poc --note "poc-ephemeral"
rwctl dedicated estimate --org bridgeflow-poc --gpus 8 --region eu-west-1
```
Zara (Security): BYO-KMS checklist will ask: vendor, key id, attestation docs, rotation policy, access control list, and whether they require our KMIP proxy. I'll turn around questionnaire replies in <=48h.
onboard-bot: org bridgeflow-poc created by Kai (SE)  hosted key pending billing cap config.
Kai (SE): I'll provision the hosted key, run a eu-west smoke test, and send the runbook + short pricing note to Renee. Zara will own the security replies; Noah will own Dedicated sizing and infra ticket.
Renee (AE): Thanks — owners noted. I'll schedule kickoff with BridgeFlow tomorrow 10:00 CET and include the procurement contact for billing. :thumbsup:
